digest.key_takeaway: Microsoft has released a public preview of the logicapp extension for the Azure CLI, adding local project creation, workflow authoring, a runtime lifecycle, connector management, run inspection, and test scaffolding for Logic Apps Standard, work that previously required the VS Code extension. The product team pitches the terminal surface as determinism for AI-assisted development. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

articles.title: After a breach, your logs are testimony, not evidence
articles.summary:
Picture a Tuesday morning. An agent with access to your payments backend did something odd overnight: a batch of refunds nobody can explain, and a tool call to an endpoint it has never used before. By ten o'clock security has the host isolated. By eleven your broker has called. If you are a financial entity in the EU and this turns out to be a major incident, DORA gives you four hours from that classification to send the first notice.

Everyone asks the same question: what exactly did the agent do?

The example is made up. The situation is not, and the uncomfortable part comes next.

articles.summary:

Over the past few years, generative artificial intelligence has transformed how individual developers write scripts, debug functions, and prototype ideas. Yet when Fortune 500 engineering leaders attempt to scale these capabilities across sprawling, mission-critical digital ecosystems, they confront an uncomfortable reality: generating raw code quickly is not the same as delivering production-ready enterprise software.

articles.title: Angular's TypeScript 7-Powered Compiler Enters Beta with Rust-Based Preprocessor
articles.summary: The Angular team has introduced ngp, a compiler preprocessor that rewrites the analysis stage in Rust using Oxc. It replaces ngc's dependence on the Transformer API, which TypeScript 7.0 removed. An early benchmark showed 2x to 3x faster cold builds. Adoption is expected in an Angular 22 minor release; production builds should stay on ngc until then. By Daniel Curtis
